period_note: BASIS: CONSOLIDATED, not Solo. This source (the bank's own website newspaper-style quarterly disclosure, a genuinely different and richer source than the annual-report-embedded 'Evaluation of Quarterly Financials' BSEC table previously used for FY2019-2025, which is confirmed exhausted for FY2011-2018 -- no such table exists in any of those years' annual reports) presents ONLY a Consolidated Balance Sheet/Profit and Loss Statement/Cash Flow Statement/Statement of Changes in Equity in every quarter checked FY2011-2018 -- no Solo section is printed in the main 3-panel layout. This is a REAL, PERVASIVE basis mismatch against this dataset's Solo Q4/annual series for all of FY2011-2018 (the whole block newly added this session), matching the same CONSOLIDATED pattern already documented for FY2022/2024/2025's interim quarters (as opposed to the SOLO FY2019-2021/2023 interim quarters) -- see sources.json and insights.json's reporting_basis/data_gaps fields for the full picture across all years. (Bonus Solo cross-check figures are detailed in the notes below and are NOT used as this file's own line_items, which remain Consolidated throughout for internal consistency.) Cross-validated: this file's own figures satisfy Assets=Liabilities+Equity, NII=Interest Income-Interest Expense, Total Operating Income=NII+non-interest income, Profit before provision=TOI-TOE, Profit before taxation=PBP-Total provision, and Profit after taxation=PBT-Tax, all to the exact taka, and the equity components (paid-up capital+statutory reserve+other reserve+retained earnings+minority/non-controlling interest) sum exactly to Total Shareholders' Equity. BONUS SOLO CROSS-CHECK (from this file's own 'Disclosure on Un-audited Financial Statements' box, Solo Position column, cumulative Jan-Sep): NAV Sep-2017 1,223.72 crore / Sep-2016 1,083.57 crore; NAVPS Sep-2017 17.59 / Sep-2016 15.57; NOCFPS Sep-2017 1.89 / Sep-2016 1.37; EPS (cumulative, separate EPS-only sub-table) Sep-2017 1.54 / Sep-2016 0.53 -- close to but genuinely different from this file's own Consolidated figures (EPS 1.58 cumulative, NAVPS 17.63), a smaller Solo/Consolidated gap than some other quarters but still a real, documented difference.
